question: Will Novak Djokovic win the 2026 Men's US Open?
description:
The 2026 U.S. Open tennis tournament is scheduled for August 23 - September 13, 2026.

This market will resolve to the player that wins the 2026 U.S. Open Men’s Singles Tournament.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed player to win the 2026 U.S. Open Men’s Singles Tournament per the rules of the tournament, the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 U.S. Open Men’s Singles Tournament is cancelled, postponed after October 31, 2026, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the U.S. Open (https://www.usopen.org/index.html); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Carlos Alcaraz leads 2026 US Open winner odds at 34.5% as defending champion returning from a wrist injury that sidelined him since April, following a strong early-season run that included the Australian Open title and elevated service metrics. Jannik Sinner’s recent withdrawal shifted the field, elevating Alcaraz while Alexander Zverev sits at 20.1% after capturing his first major at Roland Garros. Novak Djokovic at 9.4% reflects consistent deep runs despite age, with Ben Shelton (7.8%) and Taylor Fritz (5.5%) buoyed by recent ATP titles and strong hard-court form. Market pricing captures trader consensus on form, injury recovery timelines, and head-to-head history ahead of the late-August start.
